subject: CAIQ evidence bridging plan & DocuSign handoff for NovaFin procurement
messages:
From: Elena Moore <elena.moore@novafin.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control mapping and evidence handoff request (NovaFin procurement)

Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking this — Procurement flagged a CAIQ for our upcoming contract review and we need to validate a bunch of controls before we can get to legal redlines. Attached is the formal request from procurement (NovaFin_CAIQ_Request_v2.pdf). High level asks: a CAIQ mapping CSV, owner attestations for key controls, and samples for runtime telemetry and key rotation logs.

Timeline: Procurement has a soft deadline of 2027-04-12 for the packet to pass their first triage. Can you confirm:
- Who on your side will be the control owners (or proxies) for infra/runtime/network controls?
- Whether you can provide redacted log samples and a short narrative for any compensating controls?
- If you prefer DocuSign for attestations, or a signed PDF delivered via our procurement portal?

We prefer a DocuSign flow for owner attestations to keep the audit trace, and a shared Drive folder for larger artifacts. Happy to introduce our procurement lead on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Moore
Senior Procurement Manager | NovaFin
elena.moore@novafin.com
Attachment: NovaFin_CAIQ_Request_v2.pdf
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moore <elena.moore@novafin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping and evidence handoff request (NovaFin procurement)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. I'm happy to own the coordination. Short plan below; I'll loop in owners and confirm handoff channels by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed evidence-bridge plan (high level):
1) We produce a CAIQ mapping (CSV) that annotates Redwood controls to NovaFin's CAIQ assertions, plus a short narrative field describing how the control is implemented.
2) Evidence staging: a read-only Drive folder where we side-load artifacts (runtime logs, configuration snapshots, key-rotation receipts).
3) Owner attestation: use DocuSign envelopes for a small set of control owners (Ops, Security, Platform). DocuSign gives the audit trail you mentioned.
4) Redaction & sample guidance: we'll provide redacted log samples and a description of redaction methodology; we can also provide a scrubbed sample pipeline for telemetry.

I'll attach our evidence-bridge template to get started. Can you confirm who the procurement contact is (email) so I can pre-seed the DocuSign envelope recipients? Also, any constraints on the Drive (SFTP only, corporate Drive, or vendor portal)?

We can book a 30-minute sync this week if helpful — I suggest Tue or Wed morning PST.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
Attachment: evidence-bridge-template.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Elena Moore <elena.moore@novafin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping and evidence handoff request (NovaFin procurement)

Thanks Ava — quick operational notes from the runtime/evidence side so we set expectations:

- Log samples: we can provide 7-14 days of scrubbed access logs and a sample of KV cache rotation entries. For telemetry, we'll include a 24-hour trace extract showing request routing and model variant fallback events. All samples will be redacted for PII and tenant identifiers; we'll include a redaction manifest.
- Key rotation proof: attestations + KMS audit entries (timestamps + key ids). We can provide HSM attestation metadata where available.
- Control owners:
  - Platform infra controls: Marissa Cole (cc'd)
  - Runtime telemetry & observability: Soojin Lee (me)
  - Key management & rotation: Ava Chen

Delivery method: Drive folder (Redwood Sharing) + DocuSign for attestations. If NovaFin requires artifacts in a portal or SFTP, we can push a one-time bundle.

I'll prepare the artifacts index and a short README for reviewers. Ava — if you want, I can draft the DocuSign text for each control owner so the envelopes are ready to go.

On the call availability: Tue 2027-03-23 09:00-10:00 PST should work for me.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Principal Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Elena Moore <elena.moore@novafin.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@novafin.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control mapping and evidence handoff request (NovaFin procurement)

Ava / Soojin — appreciate the fast response and the proposed plan. Procurement confirms DocuSign is preferred for owner attestations; I'll ask procurement@novafin.com to expect envelopes from redwood-docusign@redwood.com.

Two quick clarifications before we sync:
- Redaction: We need a brief statement about the redaction process for logs (steps and who signs off on redaction). Is a one-paragraph policy note + redaction manifest acceptable?
- SLA for samples: what's the expected turnaround once we request an additional log slice during their review window? Procurement would like to know if you can turn around an extra 2-day extract within 48 hours.

I've attached the SOW procurement referenced (Procurement_SOW_v1.docx) — it includes the audit window and a contact for legal. If we can get the CAIQ mapping + staged Drive folder and attestations into DocuSign by 2027-04-05, that would give us buffer before the procurement triage.

Procurement also asked for a HubSpot link or DocuSign reference once the envelope is sent so they can track.

Talk soon — I'll be on the Tue 09:00 PST call.

Best,
Elena
Attachment: Procurement_SOW_v1.docx
